injectionGuard.description: Prompt-injection defences. toolHardGate.description: Dangerous-tool hard gate (ADR 0036). Always on and independent of execApprovalMode: tools that manage members, publish content, move money or change the bot's identity (a core list, plus tools that declare risk: dangerous) never run without a fresh human approval or a Console-approved card, even under bypass. A denial fails closed and is not retried in the same turn. Settings can only make it stricter.

judgeIntervalMs.description: 没在对话时，同一个群至少隔这么久才判断一次（毫秒，默认 30000），节省判断模型的额度

sceneEvents.description: 状态感知：禁言/解禁、入群申请、成员进出、公告变更、戳 Bot 等高优先社交事件独立唤醒一次回合（不必等下一条人话）；表情回应、名片/头衔变更等低优先事件不单独唤醒，只在下一轮 [Scene events] 摘要里出现。Bot 不能发言时只更新会话画像，不调用模型。

conversations.description: 允许被社交事件唤醒的群/频道，格式 platform:sceneId；* 表示所有群。缺省沿用 ai.trigger.ambient.conversations（都没配则不唤醒）

en.description: Groups/channels that social events may wake, as platform:sceneId; * for every group. Defaults to ai.trigger.ambient.conversations (no wake when neither is set)

coalesceMs.description: 同一场景的合并窗口（毫秒，限定 3000～5000，默认 4000）

en.description: Coalesce window per scene in ms, clamped to 3000–5000 (default 4000)

minIntervalMs.description: 同一场景两次唤醒的最短间隔（毫秒，默认 15000）；未到时间的批次顺延，不丢

en.description: Minimum gap between two wakes in one scene in ms (default 15000); early batches are deferred, not dropped

Scene awareness: high-priority social events (bot muted/unmuted, join request, member joined/left, notice updated, bot poked) wake one turn on their own without waiting for the next human message; low-priority events (reactions, card/title changes) never wake alone and only appear in the next turn's [Scene events] summary. When the bot cannot speak, only the session profile is updated and the model is not called.
